comment: Read from the source at tag v2.1.14 (commit 75e5f70), which is the installed build. Param 0 (FADE_PARAM) is declared and configured but has no widget and is never read, so it gets no line. The FOLLOW, UNDO and REDO buttons under the screen are plain widgets rather than ParamWidgets, so no click on them can reach this feature; they are covered by a Note instead. Index order is not panel order here: input 5 is the TRIG TYPE gate on the right and input 6 the BOUNCE gate beside it, the reverse of what the enum order suggests. The maker's page says right-click and drag moves the view; in the code any drag on the screen moves it and a left click opens the node menu.
